content: Rifapentine, marketed under the brand name PRIFTIN, is an oral antibiotic formulation. Each tablet contains 150 mg of the active ingredient rifapentine. In addition to the active ingredient, the tablets include several inactive components: calcium stearate, disodium EDTA, FD&C Blue No. 2 aluminum lake, hydroxypropyl cellulose, hypromellose USP, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, pregelatinized starch, propylene glycol, sodium ascorbate, sodium lauryl sulfate, sodium starch glycolate, synthetic red iron oxide, and titanium dioxide. Rifapentine belongs to the rifamycin class of antibiotics and exhibits a microbiological activity profile similar to that of rifampin (also known as rifampicin). Its molecular formula is C47H64N4O12. The chemical name of rifapentine is rifamycin, 3-methyl]or 3-rifamycin or 5,6,9,17,19,21-hexahydroxy-23-methoxy-2,4,12,16,18,20,22-heptamethyl-8-[2,7-(epoxypentadecatrienimino)]naphthofuran-1,11(2H)-dione 21-acetate.
